## Motivation

fixes: #7979 

## Solution

When we receive a CQ that contains a cancelled event (open op), we now close the related fd.

## result of PoC run after the fix

```sh
thread 'main' (1) panicked at src/main.rs:58:9:
expected many leaked fds, saw 1
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
before=7
after=8
leaked=1
```

comments.body: We can make a point release with this if you change the base to `tokio-1.50.x`

@mattiapitossi Follow what @mufeedvh said. 

This `cancel_op` function is located here: https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/blob/master/tokio/src/runtime/io/driver/uring.rs#L259

This function gets called the drop glue of each `Op` io uring operation here: https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/blob/master/tokio/src/runtime/driver/op.rs#L86

So handle this case in the `cancel_op`
@mufeedvh all the cases should now be covered, I added also a new test based on your PoC for the dropped and never re-polled case

I'll go ahead and merge this. @Daksh14 my understanding is that the code is correct in the current state where only `Open` exists, but that it can be improved for when other fd-owning ops are added and that it may be error-prone. Still, to unblock I'd like to merge this now.

reviews.body: Closing the cancelled open fd with `OwnedFd::from_raw_fd` on `Lifecycle::Cancelled(CancelData::Open(_))` fixes the leak. nit: the regression test allows up to 64 extra fds (`leaked <= 64`) — catches a gross leak but could miss a small steady drip.
The fix looks okay. As discussed on discord, we can make improvements in a follow-up.

title: rt: do not leak fd when cancelling io_uring open operation
